items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: But last year she didn't sing close or walk with me, but this year she did.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, when we was working there, we used to play that a many times with him, but we never faded off a record. But that was his favorite number, you know, that was one of the numbers that made him famous, Canal Street Blues. But, I'll say this, the fellas is passing off, the New Year's starts off kind of rough, but it's slowing up a little bit, and I hope it stays slow for a long time. Because we have quite a few pioneers left. And I'm hoping that they don't fall by the wayside, like George and Drag and Paul…
So I think there's a couple, a few years left, right? Huh? I think there's a few years left yet for the music.
